title: Super-twisting over networks: A Lyapunov approach for distributed differentiation
summary: We study distributed differentiation, where agents in a networked system estimate the average of local time-varying signals and their derivatives under mild assumptions on the agents' signals and their first and second derivatives. Existing sliding-mode methods provide only local stability guarantees and lack systematic gain selection.
